title: 2025 Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents

verified_observations.annual_accident_rates: Report contains accident rates and onboard fatalities by year, 1959-2025, per one million departures.
verified_observations.aggregate_exposure: Report contains worldwide departures and flight-hours over time and reports cumulative Boeing-vs-total shares.
verified_observations.airplane_type_rates: Report contains hull-loss accident rates by airplane type over cumulative operating history.
verified_observations.current_year_event_table: Report contains event-level 2025 airplane accident summaries.

limitations: The verified 2025 report does not by itself provide a machine-readable event-level 2010-2025 Boeing-only census matching BSFM target semantics.

The verified report exposes aggregate annual worldwide traffic and cumulative airplane-type accident rates, but this review did not establish annual departures/cycles for every BSFM Boeing family-year cell from 2010-2025.
Cumulative airplane-type rates must not be transformed into annual family exposure without source evidence.
Boeing report inclusion/exclusion definitions must be reconciled with the BSFM target before G1 attestation.
